name: io.github.JoaoBerne/cli-bridge-mcp
description: Consult a council of AI CLIs (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Mistral, Qwen, Copilot, OpenCode…) from inside any MCP client — free and ban-safe.

environment_variables.name: CLI_BRIDGE_PROFILE
environment_variables.description: Cost profile: saver (free-only fan-out, include_paid refused) | balanced (paid only with include_paid) | max (limited/paid join fan-out).

environment_variables.name: CLI_BRIDGE_TERSE
environment_variables.description: Response-style preamble level: off | lite (default) | full | ultra.

environment_variables.name: CLI_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_S
environment_variables.description: Response cache TTL in seconds. 0 = off (default).
